entities.name: UE
entities.description: User Equipment that receives messages containing unknown Information Elements.

entities.name: Network
entities.description: Network entity that receives messages containing unknown Information Elements.

entities.name: Unknown IE not comprehension required
entities.description: Information Element that is unknown to the receiver and not encoded as comprehension required.

entities.name: Ignore action
entities.description: Action to disregard unknown Information Elements that are not comprehension required.

relations.description: UE shall perform ignore action when encountering unknown IEs not comprehension required.
Network shall perform ignore action when encountering unknown IEs not comprehension required.
Condition of unknown IE not comprehension required triggers the ignore action.
